Which is more boring: being alone at home, or being alone out on the street? The street, easily.

Alone at home is plenty interesting. You are comfortable, you are online, and the internet will fill every empty minute. Alone on the street is a different thing — you are by yourself, surrounded by everyone who looks perfectly happy.
